::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 8th [1871]  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95[^1]
:::

My dear [Miss Sewell](people/person_1301.qmd)
I think I can make room for your two papers in November and December, having pretty well got over what choked me up at the beginning of the month.[^2]

I ought to have written before and I am sorry I did not.

Yours sincerely
C M  Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: The next two papers by Sewell to appear in *MP* were 'Questions of the Day: Reason and Faith' (November 1871), 421-427, and 'Questions of the Day: The Limits of Evidence' (February 1872), 111-118, both part of an occasional series published between June 1871 and May 1875, collected as *Some Questions of the Day* (1875).
